rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_dm_incidence(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) DEFAULT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) DEFAULT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) DEFAULT NULL,
  target int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result10 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result11 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result12 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result01 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result02 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result03 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result04 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result05 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result06 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result07 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result08 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result09 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_dm_incidence WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_dm_incidence (id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year)
SELECT
	 @id,v.hospcode,v.villcode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com
	,(@b_year+543) as b_year
FROM
cvillage_hosp v
WHERE LENGTH(v.villcode)=8;

UPDATE s_dm_incidence s INNER JOIN (	
		SELECT villcode,SUM(total) total 
		FROM cmidyearpop 
		WHERE (SUBSTR(yearmonth,1,4)-543) = @b_year	AND SUBSTR(villcode,1,2) = @prov_c 	
		GROUP BY villcode 
	) as p  ON  s.areacode=p.villcode
SET s.target=p.total
WHERE s.b_year=(@b_year+543);

UPDATE s_dm_incidence s INNER JOIN (	
		SELECT 
		p.check_vhid  vhid
		,COUNT(DISTINCT t.cid) result
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.min_date_dx_dm,'%m') IN (10),t.cid,NULL)) result10
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.min_date_dx_dm,'%m') IN (11),t.cid,NULL)) result11
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.min_date_dx_dm,'%m') IN (12),t.cid,NULL)) result12
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.min_date_dx_dm,'%m') IN (1),t.cid,NULL)) result01
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.min_date_dx_dm,'%m') IN (2),t.cid,NULL)) result02
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.min_date_dx_dm,'%m') IN (3),t.cid,NULL)) result03
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.min_date_dx_dm,'%m') IN (4),t.cid,NULL)) result04
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.min_date_dx_dm,'%m') IN (5),t.cid,NULL)) result05
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.min_date_dx_dm,'%m') IN (6),t.cid,NULL)) result06
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.min_date_dx_dm,'%m') IN (7),t.cid,NULL)) result07
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.min_date_dx_dm,'%m') IN (8),t.cid,NULL)) result08
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.min_date_dx_dm,'%m') IN (9),t.cid,NULL)) result09
		FROM
		t_dmht t  INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON t.cid=p.cid
		INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
		WHERE min_date_dx_dm BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d  AND LENGTH(t.cid)=13
		AND  type_dx IN(2,3)	AND p.check_typearea IN(1,3) AND p.NATION IN(99) AND p.DISCHARGE IN(9)
		AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c)
		GROUP BY p.check_vhid
) i ON s.areacode=i.vhid
SET s.result=i.result
,s.result10=i.result10
,s.result11=i.result11
,s.result12=i.result12
,s.result01=i.result01
,s.result02=i.result02
,s.result03=i.result03
,s.result04=i.result04
,s.result05=i.result05
,s.result06=i.result06
,s.result07=i.result07
,s.result08=i.result08
,s.result09=i.result09
WHERE s.b_year=(@b_year+543);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("result10") as "result10" ,SUM("result11") as "result11" ,SUM("result12") as "result12" ,SUM("result01") as "result1" ,SUM("result02") as "result2" ,SUM("result03") as "result3" ,SUM("result04") as "result4" ,SUM("result05") as "result5" ,SUM("result06") as "result6" ,SUM("result07") as "result7" ,SUM("result08") as "result8" ,SUM("result09") as "result9" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code ,concat(h.hoscode,':',h.hosname) as a_name ,  SUM(target) as target ,SUM(result) as result ,SUM(result10) as result10 ,SUM(result11) as result11 ,SUM(result12) as result12 ,SUM(result01) as result1 ,SUM(result02) as result2 ,SUM(result03) as result3 ,SUM(result04) as result4 ,SUM(result05) as result5 ,SUM(result06) as result6 ,SUM(result07) as result7 ,SUM(result08) as result8 ,SUM(result09) as result9 FROM chospital as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1
